Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```elixir title="Elixir"

{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Respond with JSON only.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Give me a user object with name and age fields.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_object\"}}")
```
